title: Run one supervised Project Lens dogfood introduction

mainline.contradiction: Project Lens has a real deterministic local builder, while Rossovia needs one project-owned supervised runtime that truthfully separates the builder's complete local traversal from narrower external focus selection and consumes one fresh task-bound authorization.
acceptance: Trusted Workbench launch resolves exactly the project-owned runtime source and supplies its candidate worktree, one-use authorization receipt, and server-formed task context.
The runtime locally traverses every declared repository root subject to the builder's real exclusions, while DeepSeek receives only the separately declared provider paths and task context.
The external Cell selects focusSources only as explanation order; the existing Project Lens builder creates and validates experiments/human-agent-visualization/generated/project-evidence-bundle.json.
HOLD releases no disclosure, budget, write, or execution authority; ALLOW authorizes only one supervised candidate with commit, merge, publish, and product acceptance withheld.
The generated bundle remains a local reconstructible projection for later inspection and is not integration or product acceptance evidence.
